title: FlashProve-Next: Verifiable Inference for Production LLM APIs
abstract: arXiv:2611.33741v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clients of closed-weight LLM APIs cannot verify whether a provider ran the advertised model, precision, hidden prompt, and reasoning budget. Existing approaches either trust hardware or third parties, or re-prove every layer of an integer surrogate at high cost while diverging from native floating-point serving.   FlashProve-Next produces verifiable, zero-knowledge-masked proofs for individual LLM API responses without modifying native serving (bf16/fp8/mxfp4, random sampling, FlashAttention, CUDA graphs, batching, prefix caching) and without disclosing weights, hidden prompts, hidden reasoning, or activations (dense profiles fix coarse geometry; cross-architecture hiding is deferred). A non-depleting Reed-Solomon weight commitment model_id opens inside proofs via hidden column openings, while local per-operator rounding contracts remove integer surrogates and the refusal-bit leak. translated_title: FlashProve-Next：面向生产级大语言模型 API 的可验证推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.33741v1 公告类型：cross。闭源权重大语言模型 API 的客户端无法验证服务提供商是否真的运行了所宣称的模型、精度、隐藏提示词和推理预算。现有方法要么信任硬件或第三方，要么以高昂代价对整数代理模型的每一层重新证明，同时偏离了原生的浮点推理服务。FlashProve-Next 为单个大语言模型 API 响应生成可验证的、经零知识掩码的证明，无需修改原生推理服务（包括 bf16/fp8/mxfp4、随机采样、FlashAttention、CUDA 图、批处理、前缀缓存），也不会泄露权重、隐藏提示词、隐藏推理过程或激活值（稠密配置文件固定粗略几何信息；跨架构隐藏被推迟处理）。一种不消耗的 Reed-Solomon 权重承诺（model_id）通过隐藏列开启方式在证明内部打开，同时针对每个算子的局部舍入契约消除了整数代理模型和拒绝位泄露问题。成本加权的抽检机制支持非交互式……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FlashProve-Next 在完全不修改原生推理服务的前提下，为闭源大语言模型 API 的单个响应生成零知识可验证证明，使客户端能够验证服务商是否真实运行了所宣称的模型、精度和推理预算，同时不泄露权重、隐藏提示词等机密信息。
en_tdlr: FlashProve-Next generates zero-knowledge verifiable proofs for individual LLM API responses without modifying native serving, enabling clients to verify the advertised model, precision, and reasoning budget while keeping weights and hidden prompts confidential.
